title: Do I Need AWS to Launch a SaaS? An Honest Decision Guide
linkedin:
Usually no.

Raw AWS is a menu of around 200 building blocks you assemble and run yourself, which is overkill for most new SaaS and a frequent cause of bill shock. To launch, you need a server, a managed database, secrets, backups, and a domain with SSL. Reach for raw AWS when you have a DevOps team or real hyperscale.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/do-i-need-aws-to-launch-a-saas/
